description: ROMANIAN direct acquisitions (achizitii directe) from the SEAP / SICAP electronic catalogue: the small-value purchases Romanian public bodies make from suppliers, ~1,600 a day. Returns the newest ones first from a trailing window (default last 6 hours; `ordering` is stated in the response; published times are UTC), optionally narrowed by a name keyword (e.g. "calculatoare", "combustibil"). Each is shaped compact: unique acquisition code (DA...), name, state, CPV code, contracting authority, supplier, estimated and closing value in RON, publish time and deadlines.

hours.description: Trailing window in hours (default 6, max 720). Windows busier than 2000 acquisitions are capped by the source and flagged in the response.

query.description: Optional keyword matched against the acquisition name (Romanian).

name: ro_direct_acquisitions
